gitCommit.subject: test(OMNI-1): take the tool's own checkbox, not one of the examples'
gitCommit.body:
test(OMNI-1): take the tool's own checkbox, not one of the examples'

The page shows each option four times: in the tool and in each of its
three example cards. The approved browser tests looked the checkboxes
up by label, and Playwright refused to choose among four. QA verify
caught it on the developer's pull request. The tests now take the first
one, the tool's own; same files, same titles.
